== Summary ==
Card titles of 24 [[Players Committee]] virtual cards, each shown three times: cropped from the Players Committee's 745-pixel Holotable image, rebuilt by swccg-cardmaker with Fiorello CG Condensed (revision 60), and rebuilt with [[Holotable Title]] (revision 62). Made on 3&nbsp;November 2026 for the comparison on [[Holotable Title]].

== Licensing ==
The card crops are from the Players Committee's card images, used here to document the typeface. The rebuilt titles were made by the swccg-cardmaker contributors.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/05/Holotable_Title_vs_PC_and_Fiorello_CG.webp Internet Archive item].
